title: Discovery informed decisions across the lifecycle

elements.text: Payment API design connected consumer needs to technical controls
Guidance on API contracts and test automation. Cross-team input on unresolved architecture and security decisions.
Advice on using AI to convert legacy interfaces while retaining business requirements and constraints.

notes:
Source: Australian_Financial_Services_APIOps_Cycles_Case_Study (1).docx, supplied by the user. Client anonymised. Engagement by APIsFirst with partner Osaango. Benefits are qualitative; no quantified delivery or business impact is claimed.

Source section 2: Following the product through the lifecycle. The table is a conceptual summary of the traceability described, not a reproduced project artefact. Design material also addressed operations, authentication and authorisation, rate limits, error handling, monitoring, asynchronous processing and capacity planning. The engagement included advice on AI-assisted conversion. It does not establish completed conversion, acceleration, uninterrupted operations or measured test improvements.
